title: On Bleecker Street at the Bandstand
description: The Simon & Garfunkel tribute act takes the Rehoboth Bandstand at 8 PM. Free, all ages, and the boardwalk smells like popcorn the whole walk over.

title: Echoes plays the Bandstand
description: Rehoboth's summer concert series keeps going with an American Pink Floyd tribute, 8 to 9:15 PM. Bring a blanket and get there by 7:30 for a spot on the grass.

title: Slow paddle out of Lewes
description: The canal is closest to glass in the first hour after sunrise, before the wake boats start. Coffee at the Lightship after works every time.
